# Another Dimension

> Another Dimension (https://anotherdimensionvr.com) is a free first-person VR puzzle platformer that runs in a web browser. Every platform exists in Reality A, Reality B or both; the player shifts between realities, even in mid-air, to cross 20 levels in four surreal worlds. It plays on desktop, phones, tablets and WebXR headsets such as the Meta Quest. No download, no account.

## Key facts

- Price: free, runs in the browser.
- Genre: first-person puzzle platformer and parkour.
- Core mechanic: shifting between two realities; platforms dissolve in and out as you shift.
- Hazards and gadgets: one-reality lasers, launch cannons, bounce rings, crumbling and moving platforms.
- Levels: 20 across four realities, each with three stars (finish, collect every shard, beat par time).
- Every jump in every level was test-played by an automated runner using the game's own physics.
- Platforms: desktop and laptop browsers, phones, tablets, and VR headsets through WebXR (tap Enter VR).
- Progress saves automatically in the browser.

## Pages

- [Play Another Dimension](https://anotherdimensionvr.com/)
- [The four realities, levels, controls and FAQ](https://anotherdimensionvr.com/realities/)

## The four realities

- The Prism Void: Glass bridges hang in an aurora that never ends. Levels 1 to 5: First Light, Glass Steps, Split Horizon, Aurora Run, The Refraction.
- The Ink Realm: A world brushed in black ink, where only red is real. Levels 6 to 10: Brushstroke, Red Thread, Ink Rain, Scroll of Falling, The Last Stroke.
- Liquid Chrome: Mirror towers melt into a sunset that is always setting. Levels 11 to 15: Mercury Mile, Melting Towers, Mirror Maze, Sunset Sprint, The Reflection.
- The Fractal Core: The center of every dimension, folding in on itself forever. Levels 16 to 20: Folding Stairs, Infinite Echo, Kaleido Drop, The Spiral, The Tesseract.

## Controls

- Computer: WASD move, mouse look, Space jump, E / Shift / right-click shift reality, Esc pause.
- Touch: joystick move, drag look, JUMP and SHIFT buttons.
- VR: left stick moves, right stick snap-turns, A jumps, trigger shifts reality.
